title: Mark generated formatters and resolvers as excluded from code coverage

authorDescription.text: This change decorates generated code with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage so that it no longer skews coverage reports (issue 2297). The attribute is added in the templates for object formatters, string-key formatters, enum formatters, the generated resolver and the composite resolver. It is wrapped in a preprocessor check, so it is not emitted for netstandard2.0 or .NET Framework. The change adds no setting. Almost all of the changed files are expected-output snapshots under the generator tests, which now contain the attribute. I added CodeCoverageExclusionTests to check that every kind of generated type has the attribute and that it is guarded by that preprocessor check. The README notes the behaviour and the targets it applies to.
